C0243.title: FTC Sues Experian for CAN-SPAM Act Violations
C0243.summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission sued Experian Consumer Services, alleging that its commercial marketing emails failed to comply with CAN-SPAM Act requirements for unsubscribe mechanisms, commercial-message identification, and honoring opt-out requests, leaving consumers unable to effectively opt out of account-related marketing emails. The case shows that enterprise email marketing without effective opt-out handling and compliant labeling can become a spam-content governance issue. Experian agreed to pay a $650,000 civil penalty and improve future commercial-email unsubscribe and compliance handling.
